headline: Canal Pump Station Redundancy engineering agreement for Contract 2026-1, North Shore Water Resilience Task Force charter, and FY 2028 flow apportionment percentages.
summary: The meeting covers an engineering agreement for Canal Pump Station redundancy, the North Shore Water Resilience Task Force charter and negotiation terms, and FY 2028 flow apportionment percentages. It also covers legal services rates, litigation strategy in executive session, and old, new, and on-going business.
items: Review and approve engineering agreement for Contract 2026-1: Canal Pump Station Redundancy
Review and approve participation in North Shore Water Resilience Task Force revised charter
Review and approve negotiation terms with North Shore Water Resilience Task Force participants
Review and approve FY 2028 flow apportionment percentages
Review and approve rate adjustment for ongoing legal services
Executive session to discuss litigation strategy: Notice of Claim filed with Massachusetts Department of Environmental Protection Office of Appeals and Dispute Resolution (OADR Docket No. 2023-029)

Executive session to discuss litigation strategy: In re: Aqueous Film-Forming Foam Products Liability Litigation, U.S. District Court for the District of South Carolina, Charleston Division, Master Docket No. 2:18-mn-2873-RMG
Executive session to comply with, or act under the authority of, any general or special law; review and approve executive session meeting minutes
